summary: Master International Accounting and Reporting Standards with our comprehensive training. Gain essential knowledge to excel in the global finance landscape.
lede: International accounting standards training covers applying a principles-based framework to financial reporting. It is designed for finance and accounting professionals preparing, consolidating or reviewing financial statements under international reporting frameworks. Participants practice revenue recognition and lease accounting, assess financial instruments and impairment, and prepare consolidated statements and sustainability disclosures.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for finance professionals who operate in organizations following or transitioning to international reporting frameworks.
modules: The IFRS Foundation and Conceptual Framework
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of accounting principles (debits, credits, and financial statement structure). No prior experience with IFRS is required, though familiarity with local GAAP is beneficial. A laptop with spreadsheet software is required for the consolidation and measurement exercises.
